title: Loops

writing.exampleCaption: break returns count as the value of the loop expression.
writing.explanation: for consumes an iterator, while repeats while a condition remains true, and loop has no condition at all. A loop expression can return a value with break value. continue skips directly to the next iteration. Selecting the narrowest form makes termination easier to see and accidental infinite work harder to write.
writing.feedback: A value after break becomes the value produced by the loop expression.
writing.question: What is stored in value?
writing.rule: Prefer for for iteration; use loop when break defines the exit.
